intro: Hyderabad's twelve zones fall into three kinds of territory for a tutor. In the west, Gachibowli, Kondapur, Madhapur, Manikonda, Narsingi, Kokapet and Tellapur are high-rise towers and gated communities where a visitor app or security desk logs each arrival. The older centre around Ameerpet, Khairatabad, Abids and Banjara Hills is flats, houses and close lanes with little parking. North and east, from Secunderabad and Sainikpuri to Uppal and LB Nagar, independent houses and colonies are common. The Red, Blue and Green metro lines cross at Ameerpet and Parade Ground, and the MMTS serves Lingampalli, Secunderabad and Malkajgiri, so where you live on the network decides how far you can sensibly travel.

The Telangana state board is really two bodies. The Directorate of Government Examinations conducts the SSC at the end of Class 10, with six papers, Science split into Physical Science and Biological Science, and 80 marks external with 20 internal in each subject. Classes 11 and 12 are the Intermediate course under the Telangana Board of Intermediate Education, taken in groups such as MPC and BiPC, with revised first-year textbooks from 2026-27. Telugu is compulsory in Classes I to X in all schools in the state, whatever the board or medium. Families also follow CBSE, CISCE's ICSE and ISC, and IB or Cambridge IGCSE.

Tutors here can combine both modes. A family in Kukatpally sees tutors from Kukatpally first, then the rest of the zone, then the city, then online tutors, and gets two or three names in all. Each profile shows the fee before a free first demo, and the family can change tutor later without paying for it. Living near a Red or Blue Line station widens the homes you can reach. In Kokapet or Tellapur, where journeys from the city are long, families are advised to mix one home lesson with online sessions, so a tutor who offers both fits that pattern well.

zone_notes.Gachibowli, Kondapur & Madhapur: Towers here register you through a visitor app or security desk, sometimes with a call up to the flat first, so expect to be pre-registered before a demo. HITEC City and Raidurg on the Blue Line, plus Hafizpet on the MMTS, are the usual arrival points, and traffic near the Outer Ring Road junctions builds as offices close.
zone_notes.Kukatpally, Miyapur & Nizampet: The Red Line runs from Miyapur through KPHB Colony and Kukatpally, so many homes are a short walk or auto from a station, and a tutor living on the line can cover the whole stretch. Nizampet and Bachupally need an auto along busy roads from the metro, and the highway and Miyapur X Roads are heavy in the evening peak.
zone_notes.Manikonda, Narsingi & Kokapet: There is no metro station in this zone, so most tutors come by two-wheeler or car via the ORR, Shaikpet Main Road or Khajaguda Main Road, sometimes finishing from Raidurg by cab. Very tall towers register every visitor and may call up for approval, and the local pool of tutors is still growing, so a home-plus-online arrangement often makes sense. Tutors already teaching in the Financial District are often the steadiest choice.
zone_notes.Chandanagar, Lingampally & Tellapur: This is MMTS country: a train through Hafizpet and Chandanagar to Lingampalli is often quicker than the highway, and Miyapur is the nearest metro. Chandanagar's colonies are houses and builder floors where a house number is enough, while Tellapur's gated communities need a gate entry and suit weekend or mixed home and online slots. Tellapur trips can be long from the city.
zone_notes.Banjara Hills, Jubilee Hills & Somajigud: Homes range from large houses on the hill roads to flats in Somajiguda's lanes, and the road number and house number together are what get you to the door. Jubilee Hills Check Post suits Film Nagar and the western roads, Punjagutta or Khairatabad suit the eastern side, and Roads 1, 3 and 36 carry heavy office traffic.
zone_notes.Ameerpet, Begumpet & Punjagutta: Ameerpet is where the Red and Blue Lines meet, so a tutor living almost anywhere on either line can reach this zone without leaving the metro. The main road crowds with students and shoppers in the evening, and many buildings in the colony lanes hold several households, so ask for the floor and a landmark.
zone_notes.Khairatabad, Himayatnagar & Abids: Rail choices are wide, from the Red and Green Lines to Assembly station and the MMTS at Khairatabad, which matters because parking in these close lanes of flats and older houses is scarce. Older buildings often have only a watchman rather than a visitor desk, and the Abids market streets are busiest in the evenings and at weekends.
zone_notes.Secunderabad, Marredpally & Tarnaka: Parade Ground, where the Blue and Green Lines meet, is the easy arrival point, with a short auto to Marredpally; Tarnaka is a Blue Line stop and Malkajgiri is on the MMTS. Homes are mostly houses and apartment buildings with few large gated communities, but the roads around Secunderabad station are heavy at office hours. In Tarnaka and Malkajgiri, ask for the colony name with a map pin.
zone_notes.Sainikpuri, Alwal & Trimulgherry: The metro does not reach this cantonment country, so tutors usually ride a two-wheeler, with room to park outside the houses, or use MMTS stations such as Alwal and Ammuguda. Colony gates near defence areas may check visitors, and tutors who already live in the northern colonies are the practical fit. Ask which colony gate to use before the first lesson, and start after the evening rush.
zone_notes.Uppal, Habsiguda & Nacharam: Nagole, Uppal, Stadium and Habsiguda on the Blue Line put this eastern edge one ride from the west, with an auto for Boduppal and Ramanthapur. Many homes are family houses where a house number and colony name are enough, and Uppal X Roads and the Warangal highway are heavy at office hours. Ask for a landmark with Boduppal and Ramanthapur addresses, and start after the office rush.
zone_notes.Dilsukhnagar, LB Nagar & Vanasthalipuram: The Red Line from Malakpet to LB Nagar serves the busy roads of this zone, and a tutor arriving by metro is usually more punctual than one driving through Dilsukhnagar or Kothapet. Saroornagar and Vanasthalipuram are mostly plotted colonies of family homes, reached by auto from LB Nagar, ideally after the evening peak.
zone_notes.Mehdipatnam, Tolichowki & Attapur: With no metro here, tutors come by bus or two-wheeler, and the nearest MMTS stations are Lakdikapool and Nampally. Attapur addresses are often given by the pillar number of the elevated expressway, Rajendranagar's colonies are spread out, and the Mehdipatnam and Tolichowki junctions crowd at office hours. Ask for an exact map pin in Rajendranagar, and consider online lessons when a family is too far to reach each week.

boards: Hyderabad families study under the Telangana state board, CBSE, CISCE's ICSE and ISC, and the IB or Cambridge IGCSE. Telugu is compulsory up to Class X in every school in the state.

board_cards.name: Telangana State Board: Directorate of Government Examinations (SSC) and Telangana Board of Intermediate Education (TGBIE)
board_cards.note: The SSC now has six papers, each with 80 written marks and 20 internal, conducted by the Directorate of Government Examinations. The two-year Intermediate course, in groups such as MPC and BiPC, is run by TGBIE, which adds internal assessment for first-year students from 2026-27. Read both official sites before a demo.

board_cards.name: CBSE
board_cards.note: CBSE students are spread across Hyderabad, from Kukatpally's metro corridor to the Gachibowli towers. Work from NCERT, use the sample papers and marking schemes on cbseacademic.nic.in, and in Classes 11 and 12 teach the board and entrance practice from one plan, since both lean on NCERT.

board_cards.name: CISCE (ICSE and ISC)
board_cards.note: CISCE sets ICSE in Class 10 and ISC in Class 12, with long answers, a wide syllabus and prescribed English literature. Hyderabad tutors who teach these boards should plan revision that circles back through every chapter and supports each subject's project work. Regulations are on cisce.org.

board_cards.name: IB Diploma Programme
board_cards.note: International schools here teach the IB Diploma, where final exams combine with internal assessment and Maths runs as Analysis and Approaches or Applications and Interpretation, at SL or HL. Guide the IA, never write it, and prepare for a demo from the subject guide on ibo.org.

board_cards.name: Cambridge / Pearson Edexcel IGCSE
board_cards.note: For IGCSE, the skills are command words, the right tier and past papers marked against the official scheme. Hyderabad families may follow Cambridge or Pearson Edexcel, so confirm which before the demo. Tutors near the Blue Line can reach the HITEC City belt at home and teach others online.

women.intro: NXTutors welcomes women tutors in Hyderabad for home, online and hybrid teaching. You pick the zones and hours: a tutor in Kukatpally might stay along the Red Line, one in Secunderabad near Parade Ground, and each can teach families in Kokapet or Tellapur online. Every tutor who joins goes through the same ID check, families meet you first at a free demo where we ask a parent to be at home, and the safeguarding policy covers tutors and parents alike. These are real controls, not promises about anyone's conduct.
points: Choose home, online or hybrid, and change it whenever you like.
List only the zones you want; Ameerpet's interchange means a tutor on either the Red or Blue Line can keep evening trips on the metro.
Meet each new family at a free demo while a parent is home.
In Gachibowli, Kokapet and Tellapur towers, ask the family to pre-register you on the visitor app so every entry is logged.
Keep fees, timings and messages with a parent, and teach young children in a shared room with an adult at home.
If something worries you, stop the classes and tell NXTutors, marking it Safeguarding; call 112 first in an emergency.

story: Sign up with a one-time code to your phone or email, then add subjects, classes and boards, from Telangana SSC and Intermediate MPC to CBSE, ICSE or IB, and the zones you reach.
Upload a government photo ID. The team reviews it before your profile is marked Verified to families. The check confirms your identity; it is not a police or background check.
When the review is complete, your profile carries the Verified badge, showing your boards, travel zones, the hours you keep free and the fee you set.
A family in Kondapur or Tarnaka sends a request. We shortlist two or three tutors: those living there first, then those who travel there, then the zone, the city and online.
The family sees your fee before booking. The first class is a free demo at their home where we ask a parent to be present, so you can judge the student and the route.
Teach at homes along your metro or MMTS line, online for students across India, or both, perhaps a weekend visit in Tellapur and online classes on weekday evenings.
faqs: When a Hyderabad family needs a tutor, how am I considered?

The family sends the class, board, subjects, locality and preferred times. NXTutors shortlists two or three tutors, looking first at tutors in that locality, then in its zone, then across Hyderabad, then online. A profile with exact localities, boards such as SSC or Intermediate MPC, and up-to-date hours helps the right family pick you.
I live in Hyderabad but want online students too. Is that possible?

Yes. Your profile can offer home lessons in the localities you can reach and online lessons for everyone else. Online tutors are offered after local ones when a family asks for home tuition, but students who want an online tutor, for example for an IGCSE or Intermediate paper, can be matched with you from any part of India.
How should I choose my areas in Hyderabad?

Think in metro lines and travel time rather than distance. A tutor near Ameerpet can ride both the Red and Blue Lines, while one in Manikonda will mostly drive the ORR. Choose the localities you can reach on a weekday evening without rushing, and update them whenever your routine or your own address changes.

Yes. Tutors who join go through an ID check, confirming a phone number or email with a one-time code and uploading a government photo ID for the team to review before the profile is marked Verified. Tutors who pass show a Verified badge. It is not a background check, and /how-we-verify-tutors explains each step in full.
What does it cost me to use NXTutors?

The tutor plans, and what each one includes, are set out on /pricing, so check there for the current options. Your lesson fee is your own decision; families see it before booking a free first demo, and if they later switch to a different tutor, that switch costs them nothing, so good teaching is what keeps students.
Can a woman tutor in Hyderabad choose zones along her own metro line?

Yes. You choose your travel zones, and home requests follow them, while your free hours show families when you teach, so you could take home lessons only near Red Line stations, say, and teach families in Kokapet or Tellapur online. Every new family meets you first at a free demo where we ask a parent to be at home.
Which boards can I teach in Hyderabad?

The Telangana state board, with the SSC in Class 10 and Intermediate groups such as MPC and BiPC in Classes 11 and 12, plus CBSE, CISCE's ICSE and ISC, and the IB and Cambridge IGCSE. List exact boards, classes and groups on your profile.
How does a hybrid week work with a Hyderabad family?

Choose both home and online, then agree the split with the parent after the demo. In zones with no metro, such as Manikonda and Kokapet, one home lesson a week plus online sessions for revision or specialist subjects keeps the arrangement manageable.
